alert.frost.activa: In {fraccion:.0%} to {fraccion_alta:.0%} of past seasons the minimum fell to {umbral} °C or below in a sensitive stage (p10 of the stage minimum: {tmin_p10} °C).
alert.frost.name: Frost in a sensitive stage (past climate, not a forecast)
alert.frost.provisional: Provisional alert for this plot: threshold and sensitive stage are SUPUESTO and the temperature source has a known bias.
alert.frost.sin_alerta: No past season reached {umbral} °C in a sensitive stage, even allowing for the known bias (p10 of the stage minimum: {tmin_p10} °C).
alert.frost.unresolved: Watch: the temperature series never reaches {umbral} °C, while the reference station did record frosts; the data cannot rule out frost in a sensitive stage (p10 of the stage minimum: {tmin_p10} °C, {fraccion:.0%} of seasons in the data).
alert.frost.vigilancia: Watch: no past season reached {umbral} °C in the data, but with the known warm bias up to {fraccion_alta:.0%} could have (p10 of the stage minimum: {tmin_p10} °C).
alert.frost.warm_bias: Even altitude-corrected, the NASA POWER minimum is warmer than station {estacion} (bias {sesgo:+.2f} °C, 95 % CI {lo:+.2f} to {hi:+.2f}): frosts are still somewhat underestimated. The station recorded {dias_estacion} days at or below 0 °C (lowest {tmin_estacion} °C); the corrected series never went below {tmin_power} °C.
card.benefit.none: No indicator improves on the baseline beyond the tolerance.
card.evidence.label: Strategy label: {etiqueta}
card.evidence.model: Daily water, nitrogen, carbon and biomass simulation over {n_miembros} ensemble members (climate x parameters)
card.evidence.parameters: {n_fuente} FUENTE, {n_inferencia} INFERENCIA and {n_supuesto} SUPUESTO parameters for the crops of this strategy
card.gap.changes_order: SUPUESTO parameter {parametro} (range {lo} to {hi} {unidad}) changes this strategy's position: {central} at the central value, {bajo} at the low end, {alto} at the high end
card.gap.cost_pending: Cost PENDIENTE: no prices; inputs are measured as applied nitrogen (D-007).
card.gap.frost_underestimated: Frost: the corrected minimum is {sesgo:+.2f} °C warmer than station {estacion} (95 % CI {lo:+.2f} to {hi:+.2f}); frost risk is somewhat underestimated.
card.gap.none_changes: No SUPUESTO parameter changes this strategy's position within its range.
card.gap.not_evaluated: Sensitivity of SUPUESTO parameters not evaluated in this document.
card.gap.rain_alt_source: Rain source: with GPM IMERG instead of NASA POWER (technical mode only; not an equivalent scenario) the position changes {central} -> {alterna}. IMERG overestimates against station {estacion} ({sesgo_imerg:+.0%}; POWER {sesgo_power:+.0%}).
card.risk.local_review: Review with a local agronomist before applying.
card.risk.not_modelled: Pests, diseases and weeds are not modelled; rotations that repeat a crop may look better than they are.
card.risk.worse_p10: In bad years (p10) {indicador} is {valor:.3g} {unidad} against {base:.3g} for the baseline
card.why.front_member: Non-dominated candidate of the NSGA-II search (trade-off, not a single recommendation).
card.why.is_baseline: This is the current management ({id}); the others are compared against it.
card.why.no_improvement: It does not improve any objective by more than {tolerancia_pct} % against the baseline.

indicator.cambio_carbono_t_ha_anio.name: Soil carbon change per year

indicator.costo_anio.explanation: Direct cost estimated with the user's prices

indicator.dias_estres_anio.name: Water-stress days
indicator.dias_suelo_desnudo_anio.name: Bare-soil days

indicator.escorrentia_mm_anio.explanatio: Water that runs off the surface

indicator.et_real_mm_anio.explanation: Water used by crop and soil (actual evapotranspiration)

indicator.exportacion_n_kg_ha_anio.name: N export
indicator.exposicion_erosiva_mm_anio.nam: Heavy rain on bare soil (obsolete name)

objective.lluvia_intensa_suelo_desnudo: Heavy rain on unprotected soil (ensemble mean)
objective.riesgo_produccion: Production in the worst 10 % of cases (CVaR 90 %): robustness to bad years
priority.formula: Score = sum over sliders of weight x mean normalised objective of the slider, divided by the sum of weights; 1 = best among the compared strategies
tradeoff.balanced: Balanced trade-off (closest to the ideal with all objectives normalised and equal weight, SUPUESTO): {id}
tradeoff.no_single_best: No rotation is best at everything: the front gathers options where improving one objective forces giving up another. The choice depends on the farmer's priorities.
tradeoff.none_dominates: No candidate improves on the baseline in every objective at once.
warning.carbon_equilibrium: Carbon: the soil is assumed to be in equilibrium with the reference strategy (SUPUESTO); carbon changes read as differences from that management, not as an absolute trend.
warning.climate_gaps: Climate: short gaps filled by interpolation {huecos}
warning.enso_interim: ENSO phase derived from NOAA ONI (±0.5 °C, crop-year mean) as INFERENCIA while the Datos classification is not delivered.
warning.initial_moisture: Initial soil moisture SUPUESTO (20-80 % of available water); SMAP L4 or a local measurement reduces the uncertainty of the first cycle
warning.initial_n: Initial mineral N without soil analysis (SUPUESTO 10-60 kg N/ha): the N balance is indicative
warning.monthly_context_only: Monthly climate disaggregated to daily: context only. Splitting monthly rain into days erases storms, so heavy-rain and erosion indicators lose meaning.
warning.monthly_flagged: serie_mensual table: {n} monthly values carry a reason flag ({motivos})
warning.monthly_levels: serie_mensual table: levels {niveles}; rain read in {unidades}
warning.saxton_rawls_domain: Saxton and Rawls out of domain ({excede}); inputs clipped to the limit. Soils with high organic matter or volcanic soils (Andisols) usually hold more water than estimated: measure field capacity in a laboratory.
warning.scenario_historical: Real historical climate in multi-year windows: it describes the past variability of the site, it does not guarantee the future one.
warning.scenario_hypothetical: Hypothetical scenario built from real historical years; it is not a forecast or an official climate projection.
warning.simulated: All results are simulated (nature 'simulado'): they estimate trends and trade-offs between strategies; they are not measurements or harvest guarantees.
warning.soil_cn_fallback: Soil C:N missing from SoilGrids: the SUPUESTO fallback is used
warning.soilgrids_andisol_mo: SoilGrids 2.0 limitation in Andean Andisols: organic matter may be underestimated (reported {mo} %); local calibration of theta_cc or organic matter by the farmer matters.
warning.succession_family: Family {familia} has no match in the catalogue: rule not applied
warning.succession_none: The lot's climate has no succession rules with a numeric interval (INV-ROT §5.2): succession does not restrict the search; review with the local agronomist
